title: A smoother city on mobile
summary: Navigation, customization, and onboarding now fit smaller screens more comfortably.
changes: Added Changelog beside the city logo. Open it to see past updates in a panel that slides down from the top; use the bottom arrow to tuck it away.
Made tower and project sheets, theme cards, text, and tap targets easier to use on phones. Closed panels no longer leave hidden controls in the keyboard navigation.
Improved small-screen and landscape layouts for invitations, profile editing, and plot placement. Invitation links stay readable, and the location selection controls fit on screen.
Added a visible close button to mobile search, kept the city logo visible while searching, and improved navigation through search results.
Fixed mobile onboarding spotlights to point at the bottom navigation controls and visible tower layers. Guide bubbles now stay within the screen, including after resizing.
Improved mobile map framing and prevented drags and multi-touch gestures from accidentally selecting a tower or plot.
Adjusted panels and inputs for the on-screen keyboard, and made opening another panel close conflicting navigation views.
Corrected the GitHub reward help text to show the existing daily limit of 200 XP and 200 bricks.
